newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso recoups, ends slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso recoups, ends slightly weaker.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso MXAAA recovered some ground that was lost in earlier trade to close 0.8 of a centavo weaker on Monday at 7.7200/7.7250 per dollar as dealers began to sell dollars.
"The market has fluctuated. At the open, dealers bought dollars to cover positions, then once the peso reached 7.75 per dollar, they began to sell dollars," said a trader.
Meanwhile, the benchmark 48-hour and 24-hour peso contracts were 0.1 and 0.2 of a centavo weaker respectively, at 7.7250/7.7350 and 7.7200/7.7300 per dollar.
Traders said dollars sold prior to the same-day market closing may have been bought by local corporations when the market was speculative last week.
"I feel that some of the dollars that were sold had been bought by corporations at a high rate (in pesos) last week," another trader added.
Traders said they expected the peso to weaken again to around 7.75 per dollar prior to the close.
